Posts.RecruitPostName: Overseas Financial and Public Affairs-International Public Affairs Manager
Posts.Responsibility:
About the Role
We are looking for a Public Affairs Manager to join our Financial Public Affairs team and support our rapidly growing fintech global business. Based in Hong Kong or Shenzhen, you will be instrumental in building and maintaining strategic relationships with regulators, policymakers, and key industry stakeholders across Hong Kong and some of the other global markets.

Responsibilities
●Establish and maintain proactive relationships with financial regulatory bodies, policymakers, and industry associations in Hong Kong and other key markets. Build group-level communication channels to stay informed of policy developments and advocate the company's business value.
●Monitor and interpret financial regulatory policies and trends across key jurisdictions. Coordinate regulatory sandbox applications, compliance initiatives, and strategic responses to support compliant business growth.
●Lead international licensing applications and market entry projects. Develop market entry strategies, compliance roadmaps, and regulatory research reports as needed.
●Actively participate in industry forums, regulatory consultations, and thought leadership initiatives to shape industry dialogue and elevate the company's profile.
●Partner with legal, compliance, and business teams across jurisdictions to align cross-border strategies and coordinate on major initiatives.

Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Studios Art Department brings together artists who focus on creative work across concept design, 3D modeling, animation, VFX, technical art, and cinematics. Driven by a shared love for games, the team explores how new and emerging technology can elevate our craft — building visually forward-looking IP and raising the bar on art quality across Lightspeed's games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a Senior Technical Artist dedicated to rendering for an unannounced next-generation title built in Unreal Engine 5. You will own shaders, rendering systems, and environment tooling; translating visual ambition into something that holds a real frame budget. This is a graphics-technical role rather than a generalist art-pipeline or art-authoring role. It sits with the art team but works at the level of the renderer.Author and maintain the project's shader and material systems in UE5 and set the technical standards that environment and art teams build against.
Work hands-on with UE5's core rendering stack: Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and MegaLights, including their costs, limitations, and behaviors across target platforms.
Build and maintain environment and content tooling that helps artists author correctly within those systems.
Extend and improve the existing art pipeline in collaboration with engineering and production; this role supports pipeline work, not a greenfield pipeline build.
Prototype graphics features and diagnose rendering, shader, and in-engine issues alongside art, engineering, and production teams.
Profile and optimize GPU and CPU frame time, memory, and visual-quality trade-offs, and make the case with measured data.
Document technical decisions and share knowledge so the solutions you build stay maintainable by the wider team.

Who We Look For
Hands-on Unreal Engine 5 experience is essential.
Deep, engineer-level understanding of UE5 rendering systems: Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and MegaLights: how they work, what they cost, and where they break down.
Strong graphics fundamentals: real-time rendering pipelines, physically based rendering (PBR), lighting and shadowing models, GPU performance characteristics, and the linear algebra and calculus that underpin 3D graphics.
Ability to author and debug shaders (HLSL/GLSL or equivalent) and reason about instruction cost, overdraw, and shader budgets.
Working literacy in material, lighting, and environment authoring, enough to judge visual quality and collaborate with artists while operating primarily on the technical side.
Experience collaborating inside an established content pipeline: asset import, validation, version control, and performance budgets.
Clear written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently across art, engineering, and production.

Desirable Skills & Experience:
C++ or engine-level shader authoring, and comfort reading rendering code.
Python or C# scripting for DCC and editor tooling.
Substance suite and/or Houdini for material and environment work.
Profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, or PIX, and experience managing platform budgets.
Large-scale or open-world environment experience.
Experience setting technical standards or mentoring other artists.
Location State(s)
US-California-Irvine, US-California-Los Angeles
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $97,500.00 to $232,300.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company’s 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: US-California-Irvine | US-California-Los Angeles

Posts.RecruitPostName: Senior Project Manager – Workday Financials ERP Implementation
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Finance is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the implementation of Workday Financials within our Finance IT Management Department. This role owns end-to-end delivery — planning, design, configuration, data migration, testing, cutover, and post–go-live stabilization — across multiple legal entities, regions, and business lines.
The core of this role is rigorous planning and relentless follow-through: building a realistic, dependency-aware project plan, driving execution against it, and identifying and neutralizing risks before they reach the critical path. The Senior Project Manager keeps multiple parallel workstreams on schedule while coordinating Finance and IT teams, implementation partners, and Workday resources in a fast-paced, multinational environment.Own the end-to-end delivery of Workday Financials implementations, from initiation and planning through build, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
Build and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resources, while keeping the critical path visible and realistic.
Drive day-to-day execution and follow-through by tracking progress against the baseline, driving open items to closure, and taking corrective action as soon as variances arise.
Lead proactive risk and issue management by anticipating risks, assessing impact and probability, defining mitigation and contingency plans, and driving issues through to resolution.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and workstreams, balancing priorities and resources while coordinating cross-project dependencies across regions and functional teams.
Enforce scope and change control, ensuring clear requirements sign-off, documented design decisions, and appropriate approvals.
Plan and drive data migration, integration delivery, testing cycles (SIT, UAT, and period-close dry runs), and go-live readiness assessments.
Manage implementation partners and vendors, including statements of work, effort estimates, deliverable quality, and budget utilization.
Align Finance process owners and end users on process design, internal controls (including SOX), change management, and user enablement.
Maintain project management standards, delivery cadence, and documentation using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project or Smartsheet.

Who We Look For
7+ years of project or program management experience in enterprise applications, including at least 3 full-lifecycle ERP implementations delivered in a project management role.
Proven expertise in project planning, schedule and budget control, dependency tracking, and scope and change governance.
Demonstrated risk management capability, including anticipating, assessing, and mitigating delivery risks across complex programs.
Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-country ERP or finance transformation programs for multinational enterprises, including multi-entity, multi-currency, and multi-ledger environments.
Solid working knowledge of Workday Financials modules, such as Financial Accounting, Supplier and Customer Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Business Assets, Banking and Settlement, Projects, and financial reporting.
Ability to manage multiple projects in parallel, with strong prioritization, resource management, and organizational skills.
Experience managing implementation partners and system integrators, including SOW management, deliverable acceptance, performance management, and escalation.
Experience leading data migration, integrations (including banking, tax, procurement, HR, and legacy SAP or Oracle systems), and cutover planning.
Hands-on proficiency with Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or Smartsheet, with experience working across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Working knowledge of core finance processes, including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, period close, and fixed assets, as well as the related internal control environment.
Ability to communicate in English and Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required
Willingness to work across U.S., Asia, and Europe time zones and to travel occasionally based on project needs.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)Finance system implementation experience in the gaming, internet, media, or other high-growth technology industries.
Workday Financials certification or prior delivery experience with a Workday implementation partner.
PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Scrum, or SAFe certification.
Experience establishing or operating a PMO for a multi-year finance transformation roadmap.
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $90,500.00 to $170,300.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company’s 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.
